title: Define the document and clause classification scheme
acceptance: Defines how framework artefacts and clauses are classified (for example normative, informative, extension point, profile-specific) and how a document declares its class.
States how classification relates to conformance obligations.
Applies the scheme in a table covering every top-level area of the framework.
The scope assumed for this document is stated as a DP item for the operator to ratify.
summary: No decision register entry: the agent proposes the scope and the operator ratifies it in review.
